primitives.name: Universal LLM Router
primitives.verbatim_quote: The technical headline: most AI lanes ALREADY FIT — no new code The repo's `apps/web/lib/claude-api/` layer is a **universal LLM router** we can point at almost any provider by env alone: - **`CLAUDE_PROVIDER=bedrock | vertex`** → Claude on AWS/Google credits (identical model, zero premium; transparent Anthropic fallback).
primitives.assumptions: All providers support identical model interfaces when correctly configured via environment variables.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When CLAUDE_PROVIDER is not bedrock or vertex, fallback to default OpenAI-compatible lane.

layer2.mapping: Each LLM provider maps to a unique but functionally equivalent execution path within the same API surface.
layer2.telemetry: Token consumption rate and latency per provider

primitives.assumptions: All OpenAI-compatible endpoints accept standard headers and parameters.
primitives.breakdown_regime: If INTERNAL_LLM_BASE_URL is unreachable or invalid, route fails silently to fallback provider.
